discovery.next: Here's what you can do next

hint.textGeneral: Genesy can help you run your business by voice or text.

explorer.title: Explore what Genesy can do
explorer.text: Pick a kind of task. Everything here uses your real permissions.
explorer.resetDone: Suggestions reset. They will learn from what you use again.
explorer.resetText: Suggestions are ordered by what you use on this device. Nothing else is learned.

statusText.approval: You review and approve every change before it happens.
statusText.planned: Not available yet. Planned for a later version.

morning_briefing.label: Morning briefing
morning_briefing.description: Your saved daily overview: sales, pending orders and stock that needs attention.

review_alerts.label: Review alerts
review_alerts.description: See what Flow noticed and why it matters.

sales_perspective.label: Compare sales
sales_perspective.description: Sales day by day, compared with the period before.
sales_perspective.example: How do sales compare with last week?

weekly_sales.label: Weekly sales
weekly_sales.description: A short summary of this week's sales.

review_low_stock.label: Review low stock
review_low_stock.description: Products below their minimum, with the orders they affect.

pending_orders.label: Check pending orders
pending_orders.description: Orders that still need to be handled.

adjust_stock.label: Prepare stock adjustment
adjust_stock.description: Set a product's stock to a new amount. You approve before anything changes.
adjust_stock.prompt: I want to adjust the stock of a product.

change_price.label: Change a price
change_price.description: Change a product's price. You approve before anything changes.
change_price.example: Change the price of Mountain Coffee to 12 euros.
change_price.prompt: I want to change the price of a product.

find_product.label: Find a product
find_product.description: Look up a product, its price and its stock.

open_invoices.label: Open invoices
open_invoices.description: Invoices that are not paid yet, overdue ones first.

schedule_weekly_report.label: Schedule weekly report
schedule_weekly_report.description: Get a sales summary by email every week. You approve the schedule first.
schedule_weekly_report.example: Every Monday at 8 AM, email me last week's sales.
schedule_weekly_report.prompt: Schedule a weekly sales report for me.

my_routines.label: My routines
my_routines.description: Your scheduled reports: pause, resume or remove them.

conditional_monitoring.label: Alerts when something changes
conditional_monitoring.description: Be told when a condition is met, for example stock dropping below a level.
conditional_monitoring.example: Tell me when Raw Honey drops below 20.
conditional_monitoring.prompt: Tell me when stock drops below a level.

arrange_flow.label: Arrange Your Flow
arrange_flow.description: Keep, reorder or remove the scenes on your home screen.

storefront_design.label: Design your storefront
storefront_design.description: Preview and refine your online shop's look, then publish when you are happy.
storefront_design.example: Make the homepage look more luxurious.

explore.label: Explore possibilities
explore.description: Everything Genesy can do for you, by kind of task.
explore.example: What can you help me with?
